method: Chromium headless, CPU 4x, viewport 1080×810 DPR2; operational readiness includes fixture navigation, fonts and 500ms settle, NOT Lighthouse TTI. Heap GC after warm-up; ten switches plus ten full five-tab cycles. Image estimates include visible CSS/SVG raster references, exclude vector/GPU/internal cache overhead; measured after readiness snapshot. FPS samples ten full tab cycles, excluding forced-GC checkpoints. Not physical iPad proof.
